description: Slide-part registry used by scripts/build.py and scripts/checks.py. It defines the allowed page roles, their editable slots and the planning limits. Edit here to change validation, not in code.

title.purpose: 题目、副标题、汇报场合与日期

agenda.purpose: 用真实章节生成页序，不新增材料外主题

question.purpose: 一页只陈述一个研究问题

method.purpose: 可复现的方法步骤，压到 3–4 条

result.purpose: 结果页；数字、图注、图号必须可回查

discussion.purpose: 解释结果，不引入材料外结论

limitations.purpose: 适用边界、样本与条件限制

conclusion.purpose: 三条以内结论与下一步

evidence.purpose: 文件 + 定位索引，支撑逐页复核

slot_contract.title: action title or role label; <= max_title_units display units
slot_contract.bullets: verbatim-grounded clauses; one claim per bullet; <= max_chars_per_bullet
slot_contract.notes: speaker notes; must not contain numbers absent from sources
slot_contract.source_ref: {path, locator} used by result.content_map and gold.json
slot_contract.claims: [{claim, source:{path, locator}}] used for page-level evidence
slot_contract.figure_source: {path, locator} proving the image is a real source figure
